title: Passover
summary: Passover remembered the Lord’s deliverance of Israel from Egypt and became one of Israel’s defining covenant memorials.
background: The feast centered on remembrance, household instruction, sacrifice, and the Lord’s rescue from judgment. In the New Testament, Passover also forms the setting for the death of Christ and the Last Supper.
teachingHelp: When teaching Passover, connect the historical deliverance from Egypt with redemption, substitution, covenant remembrance, and Christ our Passover.
